hornRule: At 1200 hours (day 50 of the 2400-hour Opening), a giant horn sounds throughout the Decennium — the point of no return. Adventurers must retreat or risk being trapped in the depths for 10 years. Soft quit at Floor 50 Canticle is separate from the Horn.

tiers.name: Crossroads of the Shattered Thread
tiers.description: Where broken Weave-threads tangle into a labyrinth of half-real pathways. Expeditions beyond the Canticle Gate enter the Decennium's mid-depths.

tiers.name: Pactbound Arena
tiers.description: A crucible of bargains and bloodsport where power is bought with oaths. Few maps survive the Arena's rewriting.

tiers.name: Duskshard Pools
tiers.description: Twilight basins where light and hush trade places. The air tastes of cooling metal and old prayers.

tiers.name: Veiled Iron Spiral
tiers.description: A descending helix of iron and shadow. Each coil tightens the Weave around those who refuse to turn back.

tiers.name: Silencebound Void
tiers.description: The hush beneath the song. The Marquis of Silence waits where even the First Choir's echo fades.
